description: Returns up to 25 properties by DealMachine property ID (ids, required), with their owners and their names, phones and emails by default. `contact_audience=none` returns property-only data. Needs a connected DealMachine account with paid access. Owner contacts cost people credits; same-cycle repeats are free.

contact_audience.description: default: owners; use none for property-only data with zero people credits

name: dealmachine_property_get_many
